chapter: After Basie: Cafe Society to Los Angeles
title: Cafe Society, the Famous Door and the Village Vanguard
summary: After a spell at home, John Hammond called her to Cafe Society, where she worked with Meade Lux Lewis, Albert Ammons, Pete Johnson, Art Tatum, Teddy Wilson, Ed Hall and Sid Catlett. She also played the Famous Door with George Shearing's group, and Bricktop was across the street.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well, you went back to Louisville, didn't you? You went home for a little while?
And then John Hammond called you.

Barney Josephson, right. So who did you open up there with?
Well we had Meade Lux Lewis.
All three there. And then later on we had Art Tatum. And then I had Teddy Wilson, and . . .
Yeah, Ed Hall, he was there. And Sid Catlett was there.
Oh. You must have spent a lot of time there?
You'd spend time and then you'd do another engagement and then come back in, you mean?
Yeah. And then after that I did at The Famous Door when George Shearing came to town.

And then there was another club across the street. What's the lady's name?
Yeah, she came in and she was there at the same time too.
She was quite a gal, wasn't she?
Yeah. And then I left there and went down to the Village Vanguard.
